thread:
maya: Hey team — quick ask: I need read-only access to the ops overview panel for APAC/SEA model health + service overview. Can't find it under Grafana (I only see EU/US). @aj @leo any quick pointers?

aj: @maya pinged. The dashboard exists but region var might be hidden if you aren't in the ops-group. Link is https://grafana.redwood-infra.com/d/ops-overview/ops-overview?orgId=1 — try that and set ?var-region=ap-sea

maya: tried the link, get 403. Says "You need Viewer role for org".

ops-bot: Permission change request received. To grant Viewer you can open an infra-permissions ticket or ask a workspace admin. See https://wiki.redwood.com/infra/permissions

priya: FYI the APAC model-health panel also has the "Model latency by region" row, helpful for debugging spikes. If you want we can add you to a read-only group.

maya: that'd be great, @priya. Is there a quick self-serve?

aj: No self-serve for org level yet. @maya can you post a short ticket in #infra-requests with the org and team? Use this template:
```
Title: request Viewer role on Grafana for maya (eng-platform)
Org: redwood-production
Reason: needs to view APAC model & service dashboards for troubleshooting
```

leo: Re: alerts — do you want the current model-health alerts explained? There was a noisy latency alert for ap-sea earlier that we tuned last month. Thresholds: p95 > 400ms for 5m. We can raise to 550ms for that model family if it's causing churn.

priya: Also note the kv-cache miss rate alert (alert name: model_kv_cache_miss_rate) fires a lot for long context workloads. If you're investigating inference regressions, check the cache panel.

maya: thanks. I'll file infra ticket now. Also @leo can you DM me the alert names to consider for the canary rollout?

leo: sure — sending DM. quick list in thread: model_latency_p95_ap-sea, model_error_rate_ap-sea, model_kv_cache_miss_rate.

aj: once infra grants Viewer you should see the team templated dashboards and the shortlink in the console. If you still can't access ping me and I'll escalate.

maya: ticket created: https://go.redwood/infra-req/1872 — included org and reason. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Ticket 1872 opened by maya. Assigned to infra-team. ETA 2 business days.

maya: great, thanks. Will follow up after infra confirms and then I'll check the model panels and post any follow-ups about alert tuning.

aj: cheers — ping when you're in and want a quick tour of the panels.

maya: will do :pray:
